title: SOLO: Towards Sample-Faithful and Detectable LLM Watermarking under Repeated Sampling via Content-Anchored Single-Owner Contexts
abstract: arXiv:2611.34190v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Providers watermark the outputs of large language models, while applications sample many responses per prompt for self-consistency, best-of-n selection, and uncertainty estimation. We show that deployed configurations of distortion-free watermarks, which deduplicate keyed contexts only within a response, couple the responses of a request: answer templates make all responses query the watermark with the same context before the answer, so collisions across responses, usually assumed rare, become the norm. Key pools reduce or avoid the coupling at the cost of multiple testing, and the exact remedy of a context history shared across the request leaves many positions unwatermarked. We propose SOLO, which keeps a request-scoped context history but anchors its keyed contexts on content selected by min-hash, so that siblings rarely compete for a context and random edits stay local. Its responses are jointly distributed as independent unwatermark

translated_title: SOLO：通过内容锚定的单一所有者上下文，在重复采样下实现样本保真且可检测的大语言模型水印
translated_abstract: 供应商为大语言模型的输出添加水印，而应用程序会对每个提示采样多个响应，用于自一致性、best-of-n选择和不确定性估计。我们表明，已部署的无失真水印配置（仅在单个响应内对带密钥上下文进行去重）会将同一请求的各个响应耦合起来：答案模板使所有响应在给出答案之前都用相同的上下文查询水印，因此跨响应的碰撞（通常被认为很罕见）成为常态。密钥池以多重检验为代价减少或避免这种耦合，而通过请求间共享上下文历史的精确补救方法则会使许多位置未被加水印。我们提出SOLO，它保留请求范围内的上下文历史，但将其带密钥的上下文锚定在通过min-hash选择的内容上，使得兄弟响应很少竞争同一上下文，且随机编辑的影响保持在局部。其响应的联合分布如同独立的未加水印响应……
tldr: 针对重复采样场景下无失真水印因跨响应上下文碰撞导致的耦合问题，提出SOLO方法，通过将带密钥上下文锚定在min-hash选择的内容上，实现了样本保真且可检测的大语言模型水印。
en_tdlr: SOLO anchors keyed watermarking contexts on min-hash selected content within a request-scoped history, enabling sample-faithful and detectable LLM watermarking under repeated sampling.
